title: Priest Simulator: Heavy Duty
description:
San de Ville, a village haunted by a recent increase in shatanist activity, hosts a chilli-eating contest. Quella, a little-known streamer, decides to document the event and meets the competition's front-runner: Father Orlok.

Heavy Duty is written in the form of a mockumentary that will make you shiver with cringe. There is talking to the camera, there is a village drama, there are TV strips like in BBC. It's hard to believe this really happened.

You play as Father Orlok, sharing a slice of your life. Let me put it this way, it's not one of the most exciting jobs in the world, but at least it pays well. Especially since everyone is afraid of you.

• Beat shatanists.

• Fight the boss.

• Test your weird weapons.

• Destroy everything (well, almost).

• Wash off shatanic graffiti.

• Collect money from the faithful.

• Drive a strange car.

• Perform an exorcism.

• Consume alcohol.
description_short: Sandbox with a vampire priest in the leading role. Destroy shatanists and turn the devil's village into an oasis of christianism.
